data.one_liner: Drop-in Flutter debug overlay with network inspector, performance monitor, and app autopsy.
data.what_it_does: Provides an isolated, in-app debug overlay featuring a Dio network inspector, live FPS and jank monitoring, log and error console, layout grid, and an app health autopsy grading system.
use_when: You need an in-app Dio network inspector and log console during development and staging.
You want automatic app health grading and performance tracking directly on device.
avoid_when: You are running in a strict production environment where debug overlays should not be bundled.
You do not use Dio for networking.
strengths: Includes App Autopsy for automated health diagnosis and scoring.
Features field-and-body search inside requests and responses with exact hit jumps.
Secret redaction masks sensitive headers and query parameters automatically at capture time.
weaknesses: Requires Dio as the networking layer.
Persisting session data to disk writes request/response bodies which requires explicit opt-in.
data.setup_notes: Initialize via DebugTools.init() in main() and mount DebugToolsHost in your app builder.
